name: Person One
bio: He lived the game before analyzing it: he coached, served as an assistant, and worked as a performance analyst for youth teams at clubs in Rio Grande do Sul. He later built apps and tools for CONMEBOL and CONCACAF, covering competitions such as the Copa América, Libertadores, and Concacaf Champions Cup; national teams including Ecuador, Colombia, and Argentina; and media outlets such as ESPN, FOX Sports, and TyC Sports.

name: Person Two
bio: He is a true stadium regular and never misses a match, home or away. He was part of the organized supporters’ movement as a matchday musician. A member of Team PA Stickers, he brings Copero what analysis alone cannot: the passionate voice of someone who is always there.
